quote: Keyphrases encapsulate the core information of a document. Due to their high information density, they have been found valuable in areas such as information retrieval , document clustering , summarization , and text classification .
Keyphrase Generation (KPG) involves predicting both types of keyphrases... we focus on fine-tuning Transformer-based sequence-to-sequence PLMs BART and T5 for KPG with the "One2Seq" formulation.
The task of identifying present keyphrases is defined as keyphrase extraction (KPE), whereas keyphrase generation (KPG) involves predicting both types of keyphrases.
outputs: Sequences of keyphrases concatenated with a separator token
